note: The same two displays: the sector factorization is `Form.means`, and the spectral measure formula is `recognized` plus `pieces`, with sectors indexed by `Index m` (particle number and tags).

snippet.text:
structure Form (F : Spec.Final C a S) (U : F.action.operators.H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Ambient m) where
    val : Wavespace m → ℂ
    leg : Measurable val
    means (f : Probe E4) : (⇑(signal F U f) : Wavespace m → ℂ)=ᵐ[sumMeasure m] readout f * val

proof_context.conclusion: `Form` packages the sector amplitudes: a measurable `val` with `signal F U f = readout f * val` a.e., where `readout f x = testPlus f (forward x)`, the factor f-hat_+(p_tot).

snippet.text:
lemma recognized (X : Comparison F U) (h : TraceSpectrum F μ) : μ = Y.costs.map forward := by
    apply weights_injective; intro f
    rw [recovered Y X h f]; unfold costs
    rw [withDensity_mul (sumMeasure m) (rent_meas Y) (g := fun x => (probeWeight f (forward x):ℝ≥0∞)) ((probe_meas f).comp measurable_forward)]
    ext A hA
    rw [map_apply measurable_forward hA, withDensity_apply _ hA,setLIntegral_map hA (probe_meas f) measurable_forward,withDensity_apply _ (measurable_forward hA)]

proof_context.conclusion: The trace spectrum `mu` equals the push-forward by `forward` (total momentum) of `|val|^2` times the sum measure.

snippet.text:
lemma pieces (X : Comparison F U) (h : TraceSpectrum F μ) {V : Set E4} (hv : MeasurableSet V) :
    μ V=∑' (i : Index m), sectorsMass (Y.wave i) {p | totalMomentum p∈V} := by
    rw [Y.recognize_terms X h hv]; congr! 1; ext1 i; rw [sectors_eq, withDensity_apply _ (s:={p|totalMomentum p∈V}) (total_cont.measurable hv)]
    rfl

proof_context.conclusion: `mu V` is the sum over sectors `Index m` of `sectorsMass (Y.wave i)` of `{p | totalMomentum p in V}`, one amplitude `Y.wave i` per sector (k, s).
